activities.title: Product Design, Evidence, and Your Figma Workspace

contract.doing: Complete a focused Studio exercise that prepares Workspace and Evidence Starter.
contract.why: Practice product design, evidence, and your figma workspace before completing the larger required Build.
contract.output: One named Figma file with a product-design cycle map, one recreated mobile login screen, and three critique notes.
contract.tools: A web browser and a free Figma Starter account.
contract.prerequisites: Basic computer use only. Product Design, UX, UI, evidence, and Figma file creation are introduced before the task.
contract.finished: One named Figma file with a product-design cycle map, one recreated mobile login screen, and three critique notes; every checklist item is visible and reviewable.
contract.submission: Save a working link when applicable, plus the exported screenshot/PDF/notes requested in the Week Proof panel.

steps: Create or sign in to a free Figma Starter account. From Drafts, create a new Design file and rename it “PDES W01 - First Interface Study”.
Add a page named “Product Design Cycle”. Add four text boxes: Understand, Explore, Create, and Test. Connect them with arrows.
Add one phone frame. Recreate the basic structure of a familiar mobile login screen: heading, email field, password field, primary button, and help link.
Add three numbered notes beside the frame. For each note, state one design decision and the observable reason for it; label guesses as assumptions.
Export one PNG screenshot and copy a view-only Figma share link. Check both before submitting.
checklist: The named Week 1 output exists.
Important decisions are labeled with evidence or an honest assumption.
At least one review-led revision is visible or described.
The required link/export/notes open and are ready to submit.

inlineDefinitions: Evidence: something observable that supports a statement.
Assumption: something you believe but have not yet verified.
Critique: a reasoned review of how well a design supports its intended task.
